records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for setting up North Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero activity: no project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets. Two Wrenfield emails (email:d9abade2, email:7c05b152) got no reply, suggesting low engagement. 8 days left, so some chance of self-start, but silence after outreach points low.

draft.subject: A hand getting North Partners' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking in now that you've had a first week with Wrenfield. Nothing's moved in the account yet, so I'd like to make the first step easy rather than send another nudge.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
